title: Multi-producer capture before global writer assumptions
scope_ru: Интегрировать ObservationSession/Producer/coverage с existing SCE store owner; producer-specific immutable event keys; desktop client independent of Chrome extension.
acceptance_ru: Читатели/регистраторы параллельны, late arrivals не теряются; scope/retention/stop; 20+ источников; source drift блокирует устаревший context pack.

title: Evidence-ready Studious handoff and NEED_CONTEXT loop
scope_ru: Build required slots, early pack/deltas, authority lanes and selected-provider output; benchmark LOCAL_FAST/QUALITY_PARALLEL/RECOVERY_HEDGE.
acceptance_ru: Source-bound WHY_THIS_PACKET; недостающий источник явно запросить; no signer/sender; тесты реально запускаются только в separately approved sandbox.

title: Preserve existing owners + trustworthy context intake
scope_ru: Подключить desktop client к existing SCE service owner, не создавать вторую queue/database. На pinned current source проверить documented scan/export caps; добавить streaming progress/coverage/error ledger.
acceptance_ru: Raw bytes и provenance survive restart; more-than-20 не обрывается; no scanned code execution.

title: Goal-bound handoff and labeling
scope_ru: IntentSpec из текста, evidence requirements, authority-aware tags и provider-neutral HandoffBundle. UI показывает краткое WHY_THIS_PACKET, sources и omissions.
acceptance_ru: Required missing evidence возвращает NEEDS_CONTEXT; приватные источники не уходят provider без scope.

title: Read/candidate races with real diversity
scope_ru: Failure-domain registry, serial/eager/hedged comparator, budgets и cancellation receipts. Вначале только чтение и подготовка artifacts.
acceptance_ru: First invalid answer rejected; co-failure recorded; loser cancel confirmed; deadline не приводит к effect.

title: Effect broker and resource ownership
scope_ru: Target revision, operation ID, single writer, leases/fencing and unknown-effect reconciliation. Existing Core must remain authority.
acceptance_ru: Same intent duplicate produces one local effect; external unknown не повторяется вслепую; foreground user wins.

title: Studious evidence vertical
scope_ru: Registered inspection/test adapter, source-bound failure triage, exact-head evidence, независимые fix criteria. Не интегрировать signer/sender.
acceptance_ru: Одна команда создаёт проверяемый failure/context handoff; не выдает fixture/test green за market qualification.

title: Voice and accessibility adapter
scope_ru: Push-to-talk/optional wake + critical-slot checks, separate stop path, live command preview, RU/EN project aliases.
acceptance_ru: Same typed input contract as text; false activation/negation errors measured; installed Dell receipt captured.

title: Safe skill factory and updater
scope_ru: Unknown action → isolated candidate code → independent tests → reviewable package → permission diff → staged activation.
acceptance_ru: First run may use coder, known replay uses qualified skill; new permissions never auto-granted; no core overwrite while running.

title: Offline optimization and portfolio learning
scope_ru: Контекстные ablations, skill minimization, held-out evaluation DSPy/GEPA candidates. Реальные traces снабжают offline optimizer.
acceptance_ru: No holdout leakage; promotion only on verified outcomes and unchanged policy constraints; rollback retained.
